    m.addConstr(-7.47 * vars['Var_1'] + 7.28 * vars['Var_2'] + 7.21 * vars['Var_3'] + -9.14 * vars['Var_5'] >= -35.03, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(-1.8 * vars['Var_0'] + -7.13 * vars['Var_1'] + 3.15 * vars['Var_5'] >= -55.61, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(-0.49 * vars['Var_0'] + -1.91 * vars['Var_1'] + 4.51 * vars['Var_3'] + -7.83 * vars['Var_5'] >= -39.98, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(6.02 * vars['Var_0'] + -8.72 * vars['Var_2'] >= 4.58, name='C6')
